notes: Shelf 'Farm & rural land': 8 kinds as planned. New kinds Farm and Croft are sourced from Wikipedia (Farm; Crofting), both fetched this session. The other carried-over kinds keep their old landsale.co.uk sources. There are no archetypes, versions, brands or traditions, because these are land-use kinds with no makers or artisan forms.
